newsitem.title: KENYA: Rwandan leader sacks three ministers.
newsitem.headline: Rwandan leader sacks three ministers.

text.p: Rwandan President Pasteur Bizimungu has made sweeping cabinet changes, firing three ministers while a fourth resigned, a presidential aide said on Saturday.
Joseph Bideri, spokesman in the presidency, told Reuters by telephone from the capital Kigali that Deputy Prime Minister and Interior Minister Colonel Alexis Kanyarengwe resigned late on Friday.
The powerful Kanyarengwe, a Hutu, is also the chairman of the ruling Rwanda Patriotic Front (RPF).
"He (Kanyarengwe) resigned on his own accord. It was his own decision because he wants to concentrate on his other jobs," Bideri said.
Bideri said Transport and Communications Minister Charles Muligande, Labour and Social Affairs Minister Pie Mugabo and Commerce Minister Prosper Higiro had been fired.
The rehabilitation ministry has been abolished and its minister Patrick Mazimhaka has been named minister in the presidency.

New Interior Minister is Sheikh Abdulkarim Habimana, who was previously public service minister while Joseph Nsegimana was moved to public service. Charles Ntakirutinka was named minister of communications and Bonaventure Niyibizi commerce minister.
